Financial pressure can change the way you experience life. You start calculating every expense, postponing things you enjoy, and worrying about problems that other people may never notice. Sometimes even taking a day off feels impossible because you know how much depends on you. During those moments, I put on music like this and remind myself that I am more than my bank balance or my current struggles. I am still a person with dreams, feelings, and the right to experience happiness. If you're working hard to build a better future, I sincerely hope your efforts pay off, your opportunities multiply, and you eventually enjoy the peace you've been working so hard to find. 🙌

🌌 Tonight, I'm sitting alone with my headphones on, thinking about how much life has changed over the past few years. Some people I trusted are no longer around, some dreams have quietly disappeared, and some responsibilities have become heavier than I ever expected. There are days when I feel like I'm simply surviving instead of truly living. But this music brings back a feeling I thought I had lost: the desire to build something better for myself. It reminds me that the future is still unwritten. If you're reading this while feeling lost, I hope you discover a new purpose, meet people who genuinely care about you, and find the courage to begin again.
